title: System
description: PROP-7: the transcription system a Piece is written in, as named components. ABSENT `system` = Hindustani, so every pre-0.3.0 document is unchanged; a missing component also takes its Hindustani default (pitch 'raga', phonology 'hindi-urdu', rhythm 'tala', display ['sargam', 'Deva']). Values are extensible string ids: an unknown id is preserved on load and re-emitted on save, never rejected. In 0.3.0 only `phonology` has semantics: it names a pack (packs/<id>.json). Clients show syllable and tone UI only when `system` is present (the feature flag of the PROP-8 rollout).

additionalProperties.description: Further components a later proposal may add; kept verbatim.

pitch.description: Pitch framework id: 'raga' (the piece's Raga), later e.g. 'mode-12tet', 'maqam'.

rhythm.description: Rhythm framework id: 'tala' (Meter hierarchy), later e.g. 'banshi', 'usul'.

display.description: Display conventions, most specific first: e.g. ['sargam', 'Deva'], ['jyutping', 'Hant'], ['kurmanji-latin'].
